stimulus: Punctuality one of the most important qualities of a man. It should form the habit of doing a thing in exact time. In a wider sense it denotes the habit of being punctual from one's childhood. To maintain punctuality is necessary for all human beings. So, one the process for proper utilization of time.
guide_solution: (a) Punctuality denotes the habit of doing a thing in exact time. (b) It is one of the most important qualities of a man. (c) In a wider sense it is the process for proper utilization of time. (d) To maintain punctuality is necessary for all human beings.
